name: Mars 2020 terrain relative navigation HiRISE DTM mosaic of Jezero, 1 m
licence: Public domain (NASA / USGS); credit the instrument teams named (USGS Astrogeology; Fergason et al. 2020)
notes: Elevation at zoom 14, read at 5 m by HTTP ranges (every fifth row, columns averaged in fives). Level-matched to the CTX model beneath it and feathered at its edge. Also read live at full resolution by /api/hirise (HTTP ranges, one per row, cut into 512 px tiles and cached for a year): Rover View's close and near ground, and the map's terrain at zoom 15 and 16. Levelled onto the package by the median difference over each patch or tile.
